model_annotations.Bulgarian: This line plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation value across 22 layers for four different components: attn_output (blue dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), ffn_output (green dash-dot line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” ranges from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 5 units. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” spans from 0 to 1600 with tick marks every 200 units. All four lines remain near zero until layer 5, where they sharply rise: attn_output peaks around layer 6 at ~100, then drops; attn_residual peaks at layer 5 (~1400) and remains high until layer 20; ffn_output spikes at layer 5 (~1400), drops to near zero by layer 7, and briefly rises again around layer 13 and layer 21; ffn_residual rises steeply at layer 5 to ~1400, stays elevated until layer 20, then drops sharply at layer 21. The ffn_residual and attn_residual lines show the highest and most sustained activation values, while attn_output and ffn_output exhibit more transient spikes.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across 22 layers for four different components: attn_output (blue dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), ffn_output (green dash-dot line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 5 layers. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with tick marks at intervals of 200. The attn_output line remains near zero until layer 21, where it sharply rises to approximately 600. The attn_residual line peaks at around 1550 at layer 5, drops to near zero by layer 7, and then rises again to about 1500 at layer 21 before falling sharply. The ffn_output line shows a spike to about 1400 at layer 5, drops to near zero by layer 7, spikes again to about 1200 at layer 13, and then rises to 1200 at layer 21 before falling. The ffn_residual line rises to about 1450 at layer 5, remains high until layer 21, then drops sharply to about 400. All lines exhibit sharp transitions, indicating bursts of activation at specific layers.
model_annotations.English: This line plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across 22 layers for four different components: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 5 units. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with tick marks at intervals of 200. The attn_output (blue dashed line) remains near zero until layer 21, then sharply rises to approximately 250 at layer 22. The attn_residual (orange dotted line) stays near zero until layer 5, spikes to about 1400, plateaus until layer 20, then drops sharply to around 250 at layer 22. The ffn_output (green dash-dot line) is near zero until layer 5, jumps to ~1400, drops to near zero by layer 7, briefly spikes again around layer 13 to ~1000, then returns to near zero until layer 21, where it surges to ~1200 at layer 22. The ffn_residual (red solid line) remains near zero until layer 5, jumps to ~1400, stays elevated until layer 20, then drops to ~400 at layer 21 and rises again to ~600 at layer 22.
